product.name: Barossa Valley Behind the Scenes Winery and Vineyard Experience at Kies Family Wines
product.shortDescription: Nestled in the picturesque Hoffnungsthal Valley, your Barossa Valley luxury helicopter wine experience awaits. Take in breathtaking views of the beautiful old vines from some of the world's most famous wine producers .
product.description:
Nestled in the picturesque Hoffnungsthal Valley, your Barossa Valley luxury helicopter wine experience awaits, offering an exclusive journey through the heart of South Australia’s wine country.
​
Take in breathtaking views of the beautiful old vines from some of the world’s most famous wine producers and the stunning Barossa Ranges, as you soar above the lush landscapes and vineyards, a unique perspective on this iconic region, before arriving in style at Kies Family Wines for a once-in-a-lifetime experience and a warm welcome, with a guided tour and tasting session, highlighting the best of the Barossa’s winemaking tradition.
​
The Kies family landed in the German hamlet of Lyndoch in the Barossa Valley, in the 1860’s and have been growing grapes in the region ever since. Enjoy the famous Kies Family Wines hospitality on a tour of their state of the are wine making facility and barrel hall, immersing yourself in the rich history and culture of South Australian wineries and exploring their sustainable and minimal intervention practices.
Allow a member of the Kies Family Wines Team to show you the old Shiraz vines of the Kies estate and run you through their sustainable and minimal intervention practices.

Kies Family Wines built a spectacular state-of-the-art winemaking facility in 2019. Your experience includes a tour of the facility, with an overview of the winemaking process and Barossa Valley history.
Immerse yourself in true Barossa winemaking with a tasting of two wines as you view the French and American Oak barrels used for maturing Kies Family Wines’ premium Barossa Valley Shiraz.

All wines tasted are single-vineyard and Estate-grown, and our wine guide will choose a wine suited to you to pair with your first lunch course, the Barossa Valley Produce Platter.
​
Settle into the Kies Family Wines Café for your second course and while away the afternoon over lunch with 180° views of the Barossa Ranges. Relish in the local produce and exquisite wines, enhancing your Barossa adventure. Once you are finished your lunch, head into the award winning Kies Family Wines cellar door for a tasting you will not forget – just google Kies Family Wines to get an understanding of what they offer.

After you finish tasting, your helicopter awaits at the Kies Family Wines cellar door to whisk you away for the most incredible views of the Barossa Valley. 
​
Re-boarding the helicopter to conclude your flight your flight with breathtaking views over the stunning Barossa Goldfields and the Whispering Wall before descending in to the Hoffnungsthal Valley, encapsulating the essence of South Australia's picturesque landscapes.
 
PRICE
2 people $1009 Total

WHATS INCLUDED
15 minutes in the helicopter
Guided Tour of the Kies Estate
Winery and Barrel Hall Tour
Lunch with a view of the Barossa Ranges
​
WHATS NOT INCLUDED
Transfers to/from the Barossa Helicopters Helipad.
Drinks with lunch, the café has more than just wine!
Extra take home wine (this can be shipped direct to your home from the winery).
​
DURATION
4 hours (approx.)
 
PARTICIPANTS
2-3 People
 
DEPARTURE TIMES
Daily at 11:30 am
 
PICK UP & DROP OFF
Barossa & Light Cab Service or Barossa Taxis
We have selected accommodation we are able to land additional fees apply. 
 
WEIGHT RESTRICTIONS
​Maximum individual weight is 130kg.
All up combined maximum passenger weight is 270kg per flight.

extras.description:
1837 BAROSSA
Pick up and Return
Barossa Helicopters will arrive at 1837 Barossa 15 minutes prior to your booked time. 
Your pilot will take you through the safety briefing, take a photo in front of the helicopter with your phone/camera. 
Once boarded the helicopter, they will take you on your selected flight/package. 
Returning you to 1837 Barossa on completion of your flight/experience.

Barossa Helicopters will arrive at The Louise approximately 15 minutes prior to your scheduled departure time. Upon arrival, your pilot will conduct a comprehensive safety briefing and capture a complimentary photo of you in front of the helicopter using your own phone or camera.

Once comfortably on board, your pilot will take you on your selected flight or package experience. At the conclusion of your journey, you will be returned to The Louise for drop-off.
